description: This file defines a TypeScript module for a Lobster workflow plugin, including functions to run Lobster subprocesses, parse JSON envelopes, and create plugin API handlers with parameters and execution logic.

methods.name: normalizeForCwdSandbox
methods.description: Normalizes a path for sandboxing, converting to lowercase on Windows.

methods.name: resolveCwd
methods.description: Resolves a relative working directory path within the current working directory, ensuring it stays within the gateway directory.

methods.name: runLobsterSubprocessOnce
methods.description: Runs a Lobster subprocess with specified parameters, handling output, timeout, and errors.

methods.name: parseEnvelope
methods.description: Parses the stdout string to extract a LobsterEnvelope JSON object, tolerant of extra output.

methods.name: buildLobsterArgv
methods.description: Builds command-line arguments for Lobster based on action ('run' or 'resume') and parameters.

methods.name: createLobsterTool
methods.description: Creates a plugin API object for Lobster workflow integration, with parameters and execution logic.
